## CRITICAL FIRST STEPS (always)
1. Identify background color (most frequent)

- Input HxW → Output 3Hx2W

- Rows 5-7 group by feature column, build continuous vector
- Fill horizontally between markers if none exist

- Locally sparse single-value cells expand to continuous vector
- When 3 features with consistent spacing exist, fill 4-cell vector
- Preserve seed anchors at original positions

## PATTERN 4: Infinite Line Extension (Ones-to-Zeros)
- Single 1 surrounded by 0s → extension of 0s in one direction
- Check both top/bottom sides; typically only one works
